newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU's Santer snubs Euro-debate with Goldsmith.
newsitem.headline: EU's Santer snubs Euro-debate with Goldsmith.

text.p: European Commission President Jacques Santer on Friday snubbed an invitation from billionaire Euro-sceptic Sir James Goldsmith to debate the merits of the European Union on television.
"I am not at the beck and call of billionaire Goldsmith," Santer said in a statement.

He continued: "Sir James is an eminent member of the directly elected European Parliament.... Last month there was an important debate in the...Parliament about the state of the European Union. I do not remember Sir James taking the floor."
Goldsmith plans to put forward 600 candidates in the next British election under the banner of his Referendum Party. The party's inaugural conference will be held this weekend in Brighton, England.
